checks.text: The page heading is "This Or That" and, before any answers, the text "No answers yet" is visible.
Clicking the button "Start game" shows the first question card with the text "Coffee or Tea?" and two buttons labelled "Coffee" and "Tea".
Clicking the button "Coffee" on the first question card shows the feedback text "You picked Coffee" and a button "Next question".
After answering the first question, clicking "Next question" shows the second question card with the text "Cats or Dogs?" and the score line "Score: 1".
After answering all five questions in a session, the score line shows "Score: 5" and the button "Restart" is visible.
Clicking "Restart" resets the score to "Score: 0", shows the first question card again, and the "No answers yet" text is gone.
After completing a session with a score of 5, the text "Best score: 5" is visible.
Clicking the tab "Results" shows a table with a row for each answered question, including the question text, the chosen option, and the point value.
Reload keeps the completed answers: after completing a session and reloading, the tab "Results" still shows the row for "Coffee or Tea?" with the chosen option "Coffee".
